headline: Five BSE smallcap penny stocks plunge up to 68% over six months
hook: Deep losses in small BSE issues
summary: Five BSE Smallcap stocks have suffered sharp declines ranging from 21% to 68% over a six-month period. Kalind and Empower India led the losses with drops of 68% and 62% respectively. Retail investors holding micro-cap or penny stocks face high volatility and severe downside risks in speculative segments. Tracking fundamental strength helps retail investors avoid sharp value erosion in illiquid counters.
why_it_matters: Penny stock holdings risk severe capital loss.

headline: Empower India H1 income climbs to Rs 76.79 crore
summary: Empower India reported a 21.66% increase in income for the first half of the fiscal year, reaching Rs 76.79 crore. The company's performance reflects its operational growth during the six-month period. This update provides insight into the firm's current financial trajectory for shareholders.
why_it_matters: Reflects operational growth for the micro-cap company.
